_comment: Curated game artwork sources, keyed by the catalog's wiki slug.
This file contains URLs, not artwork. It ships with the project; the images
it points at do not, and are fetched to each user's own machine and cached
there. A game's logo is the publisher's trademark, so shipping a copy would
be redistributing it — a link is not.
'terms' records what the source actually states about reuse. 'none stated'
is the honest answer for most publishers, who provide brand assets without
saying anything about third-party use. Where guidelines exist they are
cited. Nothing here asserts a licence that was not found in writing.
Square marks are preferred: these render in a badge of roughly 40px, where
A game with no entry falls back to its short text badge, which is why the
map being incomplete is not a bug.
